caption: One object fetch in order. DNS and the TCP handshake both finish before the first byte of HTTP is sent, and the server's reply begins with the same status line the request expects.

spec.title: One page load
spec.aria: Five steps left to right: the user types a URL, DNS finds the IP address, TCP connects on port 80, the browser sends GET /index.html, and the server answers 200 OK with HTML.
